examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Firewall opening: a long headline that widens its column, both actions, and one row of three arguments under the hero floor. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items drops the grid, and one with no title renders nothing.

site.name: SixArguments
site.summary: Six arguments in two rows of three, for a page that argues on breadth. The headline is short, so it keeps the narrow column and breaks early.

site.name: ThreeArguments
site.summary: Three arguments in one row, for a page that argues on a few strong claims. The headline is long, so its column widens and it breaks into two lines instead of three.
